newsitem.title: USA: Dead man "similar" to Cunanan found - police.
newsitem.headline: Dead man "similar" to Cunanan found - police.

text.p: The body of a white male resembling Andrew Cunanan, the alleged killer of Italian fashion czar Gianni Versace, was found inside a houseboat besieged by Miami Beach police on Wednesday, police spokesman Richard Barreto said.
Barreto said police were awaiting the results of forensic tests before identifying the body.
"There is a similarity in the description of the victim that was found," Barreto said. "Beyond that I will tell you that there is nothing else to indicate at this time that it was him."
Miami Beach Mayor Seymour Gelber said, though, he had received information from police that they believed the dead man was Cunanan.
"That is the information I have received, but they have not given us final word on it," Gelber said.
